scope: Instruction-qualified timing of the native SH1 control code executing in core 0.1.24, CPU 100%, Mark VI 120 Hz. Excludes physical controller and display delay.

v24_framebuffer_response.probe_observation_note: A pre-frame Lua notifier first observed the coordinate change at presentation 3085 (50.06 ms); the qualified control write already occurred at presentation 3083 (33.38 ms).

diagnostic_fresh_pad_bypass.scope: Temporary diagnostic only: replace the qualified cached-pad read with the known current pad value. This advances committed input timing while retaining the movement algorithm. No production code or ROM was changed.

conclusion: Bypassing cached pad input alone is insufficient for a <20ms guarantee at native30Hz control updates.
original_m2_timing_limit: The input mechanisms were identified in native SH1 code. Their execution timings were measured in this portable core; the complete original M2 application has not been measured.
